name: ragpiq-pre-pr-audit
description: Pre-PR audit skill for Ragpiq frontend work. 9-phase audit: TypeScript check, Ragpiq-specific Bubble field_name validator, n8n env-routing scan, brand voice review, schema staleness check, multi-viewport visual audit, push as draft PR, dispatch Anthropic /code-review on the draft, explicit user OK before convert-to-ready. Triggers on /audit-pr slash command and phrases like create PR, ship it, ready for Pat, ready to merge.
